name: suwagent
description: Review agent work visually instead of reading walls of text: visual spec, plan and recap pages, plus a short deviation page of what differs from the spec, a test guide for testers, a spec guardrail coverage page, a review-spec page that shows a reviewer only what one task did to the living specs, and a diff-level review page by a separate reviewer (also published as claude.ai artifacts), task-triage and review-triage for sizing a task and picking the review path, plan-judge for competing plans, visual-readme for a README told in light/dark pictures, autopilot, orchestrate and limit-guard for long autonomous work, mr-chain for delivering a feature as stacked MRs, mandatory-docs before code, and a session hook with the working agreement (spec → plan → recap, a 🟢🟡🔴 status line).

suggest_visual_docs.title: Suggest spec → plan → recap
suggest_visual_docs.description: At session start, tell Claude to offer a visual spec and plan before larger changes and a visual recap after them

quick_recap.title: Status line at the end of answers
quick_recap.description: End every finished piece of work with one line: 🟢 done, 🟡 something pending, 🔴 waiting for you

mandatory_docs.title: Read the docs before coding
mandatory_docs.description: Before using a library, framework, CLI or provider API, read its current official docs instead of relying on memory

publish_mode.title: Where visual documents go
publish_mode.description: artifact: keep the local HTML and also publish it as a claude.ai artifact, with its link in docs/visual/<kind>/claude-artifacts.md. local: keep it on this machine only (for client or confidential repositories)
